g.text: Disulfides are bonded terms in the force field, so intact SG–SG distances are a topology check, not an independent stability assay.

g.text: Contact map: equal-weight mean of 3 completed replicas over 0.2–1.0 ns; sequence neighbours |i−j| ≤ 3 are masked. No convergence claim.
